chart_references: But Mr Orcel may be betting that the price of Commerzbank’s shares will slide, enabling him to buy them cheaply in the open market after his offer expires. That is despite a near-doubling since he first bought a stake, of 9%, in September 2024, thanks to strong results, share buy-backs and generous dividends (see chart). Mr Orcel has also said that he may “mildly” improve his offer.

extraction.title: Kulturkampf
extraction.subtitle: UniCredit's lowball bid for Commerzbank causes consternation A bad-tempered battle for a big German bank
extraction.summary: UniCredit offered an 8% discount to acquire the remaining shares of Commerzbank, seeking to merge its HVB subsidiary and gain a 9% market share in Germany. The bid faces pushback from Commerzbank's management, the German government, and regulator BaFin, while UniCredit's CEO Andrea Orcel signals possible offer adjustments.

events.event_summary: UniCredit submits a lowball bid to acquire remaining Commerzbank shares, offering €0.485 per share, 8% below market price.
UniCredit releases a 34‑page strategic plan for Commerzbank, criticizing its operations and proposing a merger.
BaFin orders UniCredit to stop sensationalist advertisements about Commerzbank.
Commerzbank scheduled to present quarterly results and its independent 2030 strategy.
